title: [Hinglish - Instagram/YouTube only] Plugin ek pack hai, ek button nahi
content:
1 MCP server laga ke
setup complete mat samajhna.

Claude Code mein plugin 1 directory hoti hai.
Uske andar skills ho sakti hain,
agents ho sakte hain,
hooks ho sakte hain,
aur MCP servers ho sakte hain.
Claude Code in sab ko
1 unit ki tarah install karta hai.

A plugin is a pack, not a single button.
Manifest file ka path hai
.claude-plugin/plugin.json.
Wahan naam hota hai.
Version aur description optional hain.
The manifest gives the pack its name.

Skill akeli bhi chal sakti hai.
Subagent akela bhi chal sakta hai.
Hook akela bhi chal sakta hai.
MCP server akela bhi chal sakta hai.

You do not need a plugin
for 1 skill on its own.
Plugin tab lo jab ye cheezein
1 pack mein chahiye,
1 install se,
marketplace ke updates ke saath.
That is the reason to use a pack.

A marketplace is a catalog, not a store.
Ye 1 repo ya directory hai
jisme .claude-plugin/marketplace.json ho.
Wo file batati hai
plugins kahan se aayenge.

Do not confuse it with the website
claude.com/marketplace.
Us site ko slash plugin marketplace add
se add nahi karte.
Docs yeh split khud likhti hain.
The website and the slash command
are different things.

Anthropic ka official marketplace
pehli interactive terminal session pe
khud add hota hai,
jab tak managed policy rok na de.
Naam mein claude-plugins-official aata hai.
Community marketplace khud add nahi hota.
Claude Code adds the official catalog.
It does not add the community catalog.

Anything that is not from
github.com/anthropics
is a 3rd party marketplace.
A coworker catalog is 3rd party too.
The tier does not grant trust by itself.

Jo plugin run karta hai,
wo tumhare user account se chalta hai.
Docs kehti hain, pehle review karo.

What it runs, it runs as YOU.
Read it before you enable it.

Enabled plugin har session ka hissa hai,
sirf us din ka nahi jab tum use karo.
Jin skills aur agents ko
Claude khud chala sakta hai,
unka naam aur description
har turn ke context mein baithte hain.
Wo tokens usage mein ginte hain,
chahe us din pack ka kaam na ho.
Poora text tab load hota hai
jab skill ya agent use hota hai.

The names sit in context on every turn.
The full text loads only when it is used.
MCP servers us session ke saath chalte hain.
Hooks apne events pe command chalate hain.
Hooks fire on their own.
You do not type them on every turn.

Scope 3 tarah ka hai.
User scope, is computer ke har project mein,
sirf tumhare liye.
Project scope, repo ke .claude/settings.json mein.
Team ke liye enabled hai,
par har teammate apni machine pe
install khud karta hai.
Local scope, sirf tum, sirf is repo mein.

A cloud session at claude.ai/code
does not load the plugins
from your local settings.
Docs yeh alag se likhti hain.

Terminal mein slash plugin chalao.
Discover tab marketplace ke plugins dikhati hai.
Install se pehle plugin ka page kholo.
Anthropic ke official marketplace pe
context cost ka estimate dikhta hai.
Jo use nahi ho raha, use disable karo.
Uninstall zaroori nahi.
Shell mein claude plugin disable bhi hai.
Disable is enough when you only want it off.

Open the page and read the cost
before you install the pack.

Maan lo kisi ne 1 GitHub link bheja
aur bola ye official pack hai.
Pehle dekho source github.com/anthropics hai,
ya kisi aur account ka.
Phir dekho andar skill hai, agent hai,
hook hai, ya koi MCP server
jo network pe baat karega.

A hook is a command
on the lifecycle of the session.
That command is you.

Mera take simple hai.
Plugin tab lo jab pack ka context bill
tum seh sakte ho.
1 skill ke liye plugin mat kholo.
Aur kisi bhi tier ka plugin
tumhari machine pe tum ban ke chalta hai.

Read the pack. Then enable it.
If you only need 1 skill, skip the pack.

Follow karo, roz ka AI update yahin milega.
